components.name: Primary button
components.description: The strongest task action with the coordinated pink/violet gradient.
components.css: .ds-primary{background:var(--primary);background-image:linear-gradient(110deg,var(--primary),color-mix(in srgb,var(--primary) 78%,var(--spectrum-violet)));color:var(--on-primary);border:1px solid transparent;border-radius:8px;min-height:44px;padding:10px 18px;font:600 14px/1.4 "Zen Kaku Gothic New",sans-serif;cursor:pointer;transition:background 160ms cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1),transform 160ms cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1)}.ds-primary:hover{background-color:var(--primary-hover)}.ds-primary:active{transform:scale(.98)}.ds-primary:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--secondary);outline-offset:4px}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-primary{transition:none}.ds-primary:active{transform:none}}

components.name: Secondary button
components.description: A supporting action on a lightly translucent raised surface.

narrative.overview: Sakuga is a practical, independently voiced space for discovering anime and keeping a personal list. A broad black-and-charcoal canvas, Japanese editorial body typography and angular technical headings support real anime artwork. Full pink, violet and cool-blue gradients coordinate the introduction, feature, browsing sections, navigation and workspace forms. A still gradient atmosphere, selective translucency and kinetic artwork, border lights and interaction feedback give the product a vivid identity while solid text and readable controls keep it useful. The typographic wordmark, one offset frame corner and concise language hold the varied hues together.
keyCharacteristics: Early source artwork and compact introductions.
Contrasting browsing and list compositions with quiet metadata.
A broad canvas, coordinated spectrum surfaces and selective translucency.

rules.name: The Text Before Color Rule
rules.body: Status, source availability and errors remain understandable without color.

rules.name: The Still Atmosphere Rule
rules.body: The full-viewport color field stays still. Detail artwork fades with scroll; motion belongs to artwork, visible border lights and controls.

dos: Do keep search, real anime artwork and useful actions early.
Do use the broader canvas and coordinated spectrum gradients across discovery and workspace controls, with readable text and opaque fallbacks.
Do distinguish general catalog feeds from the signed-in user’s list.
Do preserve source provenance, selected-season behavior and existing preference fields.
Do use labels alongside color and keep secondary actions available to touch and keyboard.
donts: Don't invent creator profiles, favorites, recommendations, ratings or personal bylines.
Don't add a permanent render loop, full-screen pointer field, scroll trapping or layout shifts to deliver animation.
Don't use decorative Japanese text, mascots or a frame corner on every card.
Don't replace each route with the same panel dashboard or an oversized welcome hero.
